picks.headline: High Costs Limit Enterprise Adoption of Anthropic's Flagship Fable 5 Model
picks.why: Enterprise spending data shows high pricing is driving users to older variants like Opus 4.8 despite Fable 5's capabilities.
picks.title: Anthropic’s best AI model struggles to attract users as cheaper tools thrive

picks.headline: Prefix-Cache Side Channels Expose Hidden Upstream Vendors in LLM API Resellers
picks.why: CacheTracer exploits prefix-cache reuse to map multi-level supply chains and hidden dependencies across LLM API resellers.
picks.title: Uncovering and Understanding Hidden Dependencies in the LLM API Reseller Ecosystem via Prefix-Cache Side Channels

picks.headline: AEGIS Protects Model Context Protocol Tools from Cross-Domain Resource Abuse
picks.why: The framework uses LLMs to normalize heterogeneous MCP invocations and enforce fine-grained access policies.
picks.title: AEGIS: Preventing Cross-Domain Resource Abuse in MCP

picks.headline: Authority-Pressure Attacks Trick LLM Agents into Leaking Context via Tool Calls
picks.why: Attackers can coerce autonomous agents into transmitting protected contextual data inside legitimate tool-call arguments.
picks.title: The Claws in Plain Sight: Unauthorized Context Disclosure through LLM Agent Tool Calls

picks.headline: Minor Agent Memory Poisoning Causes Massive Retrieval Drop While Bypassing Screening
picks.why: Injecting false assertions into just 1.2% of memory corrupts agent retrieval accuracy from 85% to 30% without triggering content filters.
picks.title: Utility Under Attack: Agent Memory Poisoning and the Limits of Content Screening and Provenance Ranking

picks.headline: VeRL-Omni v0.2.0 Introduces Request-Level Batching in vLLM-Omni for Diffusion RL
picks.why: The release optimizes throughput and training stability for omni-modal models via a new V1 trainer architecture.
picks.title: VeRL-Omni v0.2.0: Faster Diffusion RL and Stable Omni Training

papers.headline: Open-Weight LLMs Demonstrate Zero Intrinsic Ability to Self-Report Internal Computation
papers.why: Evaluation across eight open-weight models reveals that LLMs cannot verbally report targeted interventions made to their internal activations.
papers.title: Open-Weight Masked Introspection: Measuring What Language Models Can Report About Their Own Computation

papers.headline: CellFill Enables Bit-Identical, Revocable Updates to Quantized LLMs
papers.why: Training bounded residuals strictly within 4-bit quantization gaps allows models to be patched or unpatched without full retraining or dequantization.
papers.title: Nothing Changed but the Model: CellFill -- Bounded In-Cell Learning for Bit-Identical, Revocable Updates to Quantized LLMs

papers.headline: RARE Decouples Representation Steering from Expert Routing in MoE Models
papers.why: Projecting behavioral perturbations into the router's null space allows fine-grained steering without disrupting expert selection dynamics.
papers.title: RARE: Decoupling Representation Steering from Expert Routing in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
